title: The Matrix Hub: Bare-Hands God & Model #1
summary: At the Hub, you meet an old bearded guy smoking a cigarette and coding at godlike speed on a Matrix-like CRT display! Talk to him (`cat dad.tty.sock`), read `server_rack.conf`, and reboot Kiro with the first open-weight model (`kiro load qwen`) to disable AGY-9!

files.content:
=== MATRIX BARE-METAL SERVER // OPEN-WEIGHTS NODE #1 ===
VIBECODER: "Who the hell are you?! You code with bare hands?! Are you a god?!"
OLD BEARDED CODER: *takes a slow drag of his cigarette as green Matrix glyphs cascade across his CRT*
"A god? Hah. No, kid. I worked in enterprise for decades—wrote kernel drivers and distributed buses with bare hands. Then my employer forced me to use LLMs... and when the Big Four surged, I got pulled into this machine too."
OLD BEARDED CODER: "Oh, you've found parts for hosting an open-weight model, nice! Hand over those RAM sticks and GPU chips."

[SERVER SOFT READY]:
  1. Talk to the Old Bearded Coder via `cat dad.tty.sock` (or `dad`).
  2. Boot Kiro's first open-weight model on the server with `kiro load qwen` (`qwen-coder-7b-q4.gguf`).
  3. Watch Kiro disable AGY-9 of the Big Four, then step through `cd sector_ui_grid`!

winRules.description: Inspect the Old Bearded Coder's server rack (`cat server_rack.conf`)
Ask the cigarette-smoking Old Bearded Coder who he is (`cat dad.tty.sock` or `dad`)
Reboot Kiro with Open-Weight Model #1 (`kiro load qwen`) to disable AGY-9!

[THE MATRIX HUB — /home/dev]
(An old bearded guy sits at a Matrix-like display, smoking a cigarette and coding with bare hands at godspeed!)
VIBECODER: "Who the hell are you?! You code with bare hands?! Are you a god?!"
OLD BEARDED CODER: "Worked in enterprise for decades, kid. Employer forced me to use LLMs, now I'm here."
OLD BEARDED CODER: "Oh, you've found parts for hosting an open-weight model, nice! I'm working on this server and its soft—let's take your parts and reboot Kiro! (Run `cat server_rack.conf`, `dad`, and `kiro load qwen`)"
